ev.q: 15.6% of adults who lived in rental houses/apartments were very worried about paying for medical costs
Percentage* of Adults Aged ≥18 Years Who Are Very Worried about Medical Costs
15.6% of adults who lived in rental houses/apartments were very worried about paying for medical costs, compared with 8.7%
Among adults aged 40–64 years and ≥65 years, renters were twice as likely as home owners
Source: National Health Interview Survey, 2015 data.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% confidence intervals indicated with error bars.
Unknowns were included in the denominators when calculating percentages.
